places.name: Charles Darwin Research Station (Santa Cruz)
places.ai_summary: A renowned research facility dedicated to the conservation of Galápagos wildlife, including giant tortoises and endemic species.
places.place_tip: Learn about conservation efforts and meet giant tortoises up close.
places.address: Charles Darwin Research Station, Puerto Ayora, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Tortuga Bay Beach
places.ai_summary: A pristine white-sand beach known for its turquoise waters, marine iguanas, and kayaking opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring sunscreen and water; the walk to the beach is about 2.5 km.
places.address: Tortuga Bay, Puerto Ayora, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Bartolomé Island (Pinnacle Rock Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: A volcanic island offering panoramic views of Pinnacle Rock and the surrounding turquoise waters.
places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the hike to the viewpoint.
places.address: Bartolomé Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Los Tuneles Lava Formations (Isabela Island)
places.ai_summary: Unique lava formations and tunnels on Isabela Island, great for snorkeling and observing marine life.
places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear and a waterproof camera.
places.address: Los Tuneles, Isabela Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Sierra Negra Volcano Hike
places.ai_summary: A challenging hike to the summit of Sierra Negra Volcano, offering breathtaking views of the caldera and surrounding islands.
places.place_tip: Take plenty of water and snacks; the hike is strenuous.
places.address: Sierra Negra, Isabela Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

attribution.title: Galapagos-Sierra Negra 2005 October 22
attribution.author: NASA image created by Jesse Allen, Earth Observatory, using data obtained courtesy of the MODIS Rapid Response Team (NOAA)
attribution.description: On October 22, 2005, the Sierra Negra Volcano on Isla Isabela in the Galapagos Islands began erupting, sending ash as high as 12,800 meters (42,000 feet), according to the U.S. Geological Survey. On October 25, the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) flying onboard the Terra satellite captured this image.

places.name: Las Grietas Lagoon
places.ai_summary: A beautiful lagoon with crystal-clear water, ideal for swimming and snorkeling, surrounded by impressive rock formations.
places.place_tip: Wear water shoes for comfort; the rocks can be sharp.
places.address: Las Grietas, Santa Cruz, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: El Chato Giant Tortoise Reserve
places.ai_summary: A reserve dedicated to the protection of the giant tortoise, with opportunities to see these magnificent creatures in their natural habitat.
places.place_tip: Stay on the marked paths to protect the tortoise habitat.
places.address: El Chato Reserve, Santa Cruz, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Kicker Rock (Snorkeling Site)
places.ai_summary: A famous snorkeling site featuring a rock formation in the shape of a kicker, home to a variety of marine life.
places.place_tip: Bring a wetsuit for warmth; the water can be cold.
places.address: Kicker Rock, San Cristóbal, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: North Seymour Island (Blue-Footed Boobies)
places.ai_summary: An island known for its large population of blue-footed boobies and other unique wildlife.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching.
places.address: North Seymour Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Floreana Island (Post Office Bay)
places.ai_summary: A historic site with a post office barrel used by whalers and travelers, and a beach popular with sea lions.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own postcards to mail.

places.place_tip: Check for sea lions lounging on the beach.
places.address: Post Office Bay, Floreana Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Española Island (Waved Albatross Colony)
places.ai_summary: The only place on earth where waved albatrosses breed, also home to other unique bird species.
places.place_tip: Visit during the breeding season for the best wildlife viewing.
places.address: Española Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Fernandina Island (Marine Iguanas)
places.ai_summary: An island known for its large population of marine iguanas and pristine beaches.
places.place_tip: Observe the unique behavior of marine iguanas.
places.address: Fernandina Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Darwin Bay (Genovesa Island)
places.ai_summary: A beautiful bay on Genovesa Island, popular for snorkeling and observing a variety of bird species.
places.place_tip: Look out for the red-footed boobies and other seabirds.
places.address: Darwin Bay, Genovesa Island, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Puerto Ayora Waterfront
places.ai_summary: The main town of the Galápagos Islands, offering shops, restaurants, and access to various tours and activities.

opening_hours.notes: Vibrant area with local shops and eateries.

places.place_tip: Enjoy fresh seafood at a local restaurant.
places.address: Puerto Ayora, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: San Cristóbal Interpretation Center
places.ai_summary: A center dedicated to educating visitors about the natural and cultural history of the Galápagos Islands.
places.place_tip: Take your time to read the informative displays.
places.address: San Cristóbal Interpretation Center, San Cristóbal, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Playa Mann (Sea Lions Beach)
places.ai_summary: A popular beach for visitors to relax, swim, and observe sea lions in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Sea lions are often present; observe from a distance.

places.place_tip: Bring a towel and sunscreen; facilities are limited.
places.address: Playa Mann, San Cristóbal, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Snorkeling at Devil’s Crown
places.ai_summary: A top snorkeling spot with a crown-shaped rock formation, home to an abundance of marine life.
places.place_tip: Bring a wetsuit and underwater camera.
places.address: Devil’s Crown, San Cristóbal, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Santa Cruz Lava Tunnels
places.ai_summary: A fascinating geological site with underground lava tubes and tunnels to explore.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a flashlight.
places.address: Santa Cruz Lava Tunnels, Santa Cruz, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Tintoreras Islet (White-Tipped Sharks)
places.ai_summary: A small islet with a channel where white-tipped reef sharks can be seen, popular for snorkeling.
places.place_tip: Look for the sharks in the channel; they are more active during certain tides.
places.address: Tintoreras Islet, Santa Cruz, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador

places.name: Galápagos Sunset Cruise
places.ai_summary: A relaxing cruise offering stunning sunset views over the Galápagos Islands.
places.place_tip: Bring a light jacket; it can be cool on the water.
places.address: Puerto Ayora, Galápagos Islands, Ecuador
